voice.name: en-GB-SoniaNeural
voice.prosody: A white mansion in a pine grove. On his last visit to Trabzon, Atatürk stayed here. Climb the Soğuksu hill, enter the garden, and the scent of pine meets you. Between the trees a white mansion appears, with towers, pointed roofs and decorated windows, like a house from a fairy tale. A Trabzon banking family, the Kabayanidis, built it as a summer house at the turn of the century, in the style of European villas. It stands high, so its windows look over the city and the sea. Atatürk visited Trabzon three times. The people of Trabzon gave him this house as a gift. On his last visit, in September 1937, he stayed here for a few days. Go inside and look at his study. His desk, his belongings and his photographs are still there, quietly telling of the days he spent here. When you come out, stand under a pine in the garden and look up at the windows. Atatürk looked out at the Black Sea from them. Take a minute and watch that view with him.
